---
title: Controls and preview links set in front matter and metadata-files
format: revealjs
metadata-files:
  - revealjs-controls-boolean-extra.yml
controls: false
previewLinks: false
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'controls: false,'
          - 'previewLinks: false,'
        -
          - 'controls: true,'
          - 'previewLinks: true,'
---

## Slide

A boolean `controls` or `previewLinks` in the front matter wins over its `metadata-files`, like any other key.
